transformations: Renamed upstream fields to self-describing field names and added stable one-based case IDs.
Preserved key, seed, message, and signature hex bytes without cryptographic generation.
Mapped RFC vectors to valid and ZIP-215 cases to invalid-input under the stricter canonical and non-small-order point admission profile.
exclusions: RFC 8032 source array index 3 was excluded because the requested selector is vectors 1-3.

localVerdictRemaps.upstreamResult: valid in legacy and ZIP-215 modes
localVerdictRemaps.reason: These cases use a small-order encoded public key or R and the frozen profile rejects both before strict RFC 8032 verification.

payloads.licenseNotice: C2SP Wycheproof is Apache-2.0 licensed. Source license: https://github.com/C2SP/wycheproof/blob/e0df04e0c033f2d25c5051dd06230336c7822358/LICENSE
transformations: Flattened selected tests while preserving tcId, result, flags, comment, uncompressed public key coordinates, message, and signature.
Added strictVerdict for fixed-width P1363 parsing, scalar range checks, signature matching, and the local low-S profile.
Preserved upstream lowercase hex bytes without cryptographic generation.
exclusions: All unselected tests were excluded for corpus size; the retained cases cover low-S valid, high-S, out-of-range/long, zero scalar, short encodings, canonical nonmatches, and an additional valid alternate key.
The upstream P1363 file does not represent malformed-length or off-curve public-key encodings; its public keys are uncompressed curve points.

localVerdictRemaps.reason: The upstream-valid signature has high-S and the local P-256 profile requires low-S.
The supplied uncompressed public-key coordinates do not decode to an admitted P-256 curve point.

transformations: Joined prompt cases to expectedResults by tgId and tcId.
Preserved uppercase public key, message, signature, and context hex bytes without generating bytes using installed Noble.
Classified canonical false cases as nonmatch and the three independently decoded noncanonical hint encodings as invalid-input under the frozen direct-verification result law.
exclusions: Other parameter sets, preHash mode, and internal signature interfaces were excluded.

localVerdictRemaps.reason: FIPS 204 hint decoding rejects the endpoint ordering, strictly increasing index, or zero-padding structure before primitive verification.
